## TL;DR

Maps retired Copilot `efficiency` to `--auto-tier balance`, enriches tier failures for GitHub Copilot only across one-shot, engineer, and review paths, and documents the legacy `copilot-auto-efficiency` alias without altering the 2026-10-04 certify record.

## Work and rationale

Round 3 fixed the accidental `oneShotResultFromLog(..., cli, cli)` call (freeform errors must say `agent exited`, not `github copilot exited`). `enrichAgentFailureDetail` centralizes formatting; `lastFailureLine`, provider overrides, `sessionErrorText`, and `oneShotFailureDetail` all use it when `cli === "github copilot"`.

## Approaches tried

Scoped enrichment by harness id rather than widening regexes alone; unknown `--auto-tier` CLI parse errors are excluded from tier-unavailable messaging.

## Challenges and blockers

No live Copilot probe in-session; human verification on Agents → Test still recommended.

## Key learnings

Positional API changes need call-site audits; failure text has multiple producers and needs one shared enrich helper keyed by cli.
